reasoning_content:
**The connection has been restored!** And all 10 containers are still running and in a healthy state even after 2 hours (the podman machine was still alive; it was only the control channel that was down). Now, let's do a final comprehensive verification:
1. Container status ✓ (all 10 Up, spring/keycloak healthy)
2. Dev server status (app 38489, cms 45423, boards 43781)
3. Full end-to-end through the proxy

action.command:
echo "=== DEV SERVERS (direct) ==="
for p in 38489 45423 43781; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
echo "=== THROUGH PROXY (port 80) ==="
for h in app.workspace.localhost cms.workspace.localhost boards.workspace.localhost; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:80/" -H "Host: $h" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$h -> $code"
done
